tagline: International Representative Body for Inland Waterway Transport in Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: Non-profit professional organization without commercial financial data. The primary activity and engagement metric is participation in annual congresses and sector events, reflecting the association's influence and relevance among its stakeholders.

kpis.name: Participation au Congrès Annuel
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple European countries.
kpis.description: The IVR welcomed 225 participants from 11 European countries at the May 2024 annual congress in Frankfurt, demonstrating sustained stakeholder engagement within the inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Strong sectoral engagement and international participation across 11 countries

kpis.name: Participation au Colloque de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants attending the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium organized by IVR.
kpis.description: The first IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium in November 2024 in Antwerp brought together approximately 80 participants from Belgium, the Netherlands, and Germany, covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new technical knowledge-sharing initiative for insurance and prevention professionals

kpis.name: Pays Membres Représentés au Congrès
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries with representatives attending the annual congress.
kpis.description: The 2024 congress gathered participants from 11 different European countries, confirming IVR's pan-European character and its role as an international platform for the inland navigation sector.
kpis.signal: Pan-European representation reflecting the association's international scope and relevance

kpis.name: Chiffre d'affaires
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Metric tracked annually, historical values maintained over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of 1.66 Bn € in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No references to artificial intelligence, generative AI, or AI-based automation tools identified in the 2024 annual report. IVR's activities focus on sectoral representation, regulatory engagement, and technical knowledge-sharing within European inland navigation.
evidence: No mention of AI, machine learning, APIs, or intelligent systems
Activities centered on industry representation, safety standards, sustainability, and regulatory collaboration
No indicators of AI adoption or technology development initiatives within the organization
